alternatives.option: client-side-only mitigation (Claude Code's save-to-disk preview), which already exists and demonstrably loses the signal

context: Filed #41 (v2.1): twining_why is unbounded — full-rationale dumps hit 350KB in a field session, agent skipped reading them, Gate 1 value lost. Diagnosed mechanism and proposed budgeted/ranked/tiered response.
rationale: a bare cap would silently drop the most relevant decisions, while ranking + tiering + drill-down preserves Gate 1 value; also over client-side-only mitigation (Claude Code's save-to-disk preview), which already exists and demonstrably loses the signal.
summary: Chose to file the twining_why size blowup as a v2.1 issue (#41) with a ranked-tier + token-budget design direction over patching a hard result-size cap
